metrics.joint_f1: Micro F1 of exact one-to-one matches of start, end and family. Corresponds to the full formula-and-family criterion of rule J in M1.
metrics.exact_span_f1: Micro F1 of exact one-to-one matches of start and end, ignoring family. Called exact-unit F1 for Helsen elements.
metrics.boundary_f1: Micro F1 of internal boundary positions (gaps between events); the work's start and end are not counted.
metrics.family_accuracy_on_reference_units: Family accuracy when the reference units are given. Different from joint F1. Units that the model cannot represent (longer than L2) are skipped and the coverage must be reported.
metrics.internal_cut_f1: F1 of the latent internal cuts of C_comp against the pieces of the synthetic generator.
metrics.bits_per_gap: Cross-entropy of the model's boundary probability per gap, in bits. Reported only for normalised models with full support.
metrics.rare_family_recall: Recall of exact joint matches for reference units of rare families.

aggregation.point_estimate: Micro F1 over all test works; for several seeds either counts pooled over seeds or the mean of per-seed F1, as stated per table.
aggregation.interval_groups: 95% percentile interval from 10,000 paired bootstrap resamples of test groups (melodic or generator groups). Does not cover training variability.
aggregation.interval_groups_and_seeds: As above, also resampling seeds. With two or three seeds this is a coarse description of training variability.
